decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Dwg 1, Dwg 2, Dwg 3, Dwg 4, Dwg 10, Dwg 11, Dwg 12, Dwg 13, Dwg 14, Dwg 15, Dwg 16, Dwg 17, Unnumbered location plan. Received: 16/04/2013) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the flank walls of the extensions hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the buildings without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The outbuiling hereby approved shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 97 Woodland Gardens, Isleworth, TW7 6LU.
description: Erection of single storey side and rear extensions and erection of detached garage in the rear end of the garden to the house
